tests.note: The server text asks for `... on Node { __isNode: __typename, id }`, and the test's payload leaves `__isNode` out, which a conforming server does not do; the test is about prototype-less objects and the omission is incidental. Relay knows no schema at run time and applies an abstract fragment only when the payload answers `__isX`, so it stores no `id`; Baton knows from the schema that `Page` is a `Node` and stores it (spec/runtime.md, memberships).
tests.decision: Open. The recommendation is no change: both behave the same on a response that answers the text.
